item.title: Fire Traffic Alert: Leafy Arbor – Montgomery – Residential Fire
item.description: 9:10 p.m. Firefighters are responding to a home on Leafy Arbor, off of Walden Road, where a resident reported one of the downstairs rooms was filling with smoke from an unknown source.

item.title: CALLS FOR ACCOUNTABILITY, CONSTABLE HERMAN ANNOUNCES THE CONTINUED REFILING OF MORE THAN 600 CRIMINAL CASES SLATED FOR DISMISSAL BY JUDGES/MAGISTRATES GOING INTO THE NEW YEAR 2026!
item.description: The Harris County Precinct 4 Constable’s Office announced they’ve recently refiled more than 600 criminal cases against accused criminals, cases they say were slated for dismissal by judges who cite in most cases there is a lack of probable cause.
